answer: The zephyr index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the prism queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 994 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ledge. Honest users pay that once, farms 11 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
